name: National Food Security Act (Ration)
benefit: Subsidized food grains — rice ₹3/kg, wheat ₹2/kg, coarse grains ₹1/kg, 5kg per person per month
benefit_hindi: Sasta anaj — chawal 3 rupaye kilo, gehu 2 rupaye kilo, 5 kilo har vyakti ko har mahine

eligibility.description: BPL families, Antyodaya card holders, priority households identified by state governments
eligibility.description_hindi: BPL parivaar, Antyodaya card wale, aur rajya sarkar dwara chune gaye parivaar
criteria: Priority household identified by state government
exclusions: Families above BPL threshold set by state

steps: Apply for ration card at District Supply Office or online portal
Submit family details and income proof
Visit nearest Fair Price Shop (ration ki dukaan) with ration card
Authenticate with Aadhaar fingerprint to collect grains
steps_hindi: District Supply Office ya online portal par ration card ke liye apply karein
Parivaar ki jaankari aur income proof dein
Verify hone ke baad ration card milega
Nearest ration ki dukaan par ration card lekar jaayein
Aadhaar fingerprint se verify karke anaj lein

hindi_summary: Rashtriya Khadya Suraksha mein BPL parivaar ko sasta anaj milta hai — chawal 3 rupaye kilo, gehu 2 rupaye kilo. Ration card se ration ki dukaan se anaj lein. Ration card ke liye District Supply Office jaayein.
